tZh: 关于 AI 发展的公开信
sEn: Open letters on AI development reflect industry pushback against potential US restrictions on open-weight models, citing innovation and safety concerns.
sZh: 关于 AI 发展的公开信反映了业界对美国可能限制开放权重模型的反对，强调创新与安全考量。
absEn: I wrote this summary of the past few weeks of open letters as a section of my sponsors-only newsletter, but I've decided to share it here as well. Open Weights and American AI Leadership was shepherded by Microsoft, dated July 24th, and signed by 235 AI-adjacent companies including NVIDIA (see Jensen's first ever tweet), Amazon, Y Combinator, The Linux Foundation, and (a later signer) OpenAI. It's clearly an argument designed to counter any instincts by the current US government to ban or limit open-weight models over "safety" concerns - a reasonable consideration given what happened to Claude Fable 5!
absZh: 我撰写了这份关于过去几周公开信的摘要，作为我仅限赞助人阅读的新闻通讯的一部分，但我决定也在此分享。由微软主导的《开放权重与美国 AI 领导力》信函，日期为 7 月 24 日，已有包括英伟达（见黄仁勋的首条推文）、亚马逊、Y Combinator、Linux 基金会以及（后来签署的）OpenAI 在内的 235 家 AI 相关公司签署。这显然是为了反驳当前美国政府因“安全”担忧而禁止或限制开放权重模型的任何倾向——考虑到 Claude Fable 5 的遭遇，这种担忧是合理的。

contrib.en: Summarizes recent open letters on AI development, highlighting industry positions on open-weight models and safety.
contrib.zh: 总结了近期关于 AI 发展的公开信，突出了业界对开放权重模型和安全性的立场。

contrib.en: Notes the open letter 'Open Weights and American AI Leadership' signed by 235 companies, supporting open-weight models and distillation.
contrib.zh: 注意到由 235 家公司签署的公开信《开放权重与美国 AI 领导力》，支持开放权重模型和蒸馏。

contrib.en: Contrasts Anthropic's response, which emphasizes risks of authoritarian misuse and calls for regulation of distillation.
contrib.zh: 对比了 Anthropic 的回应，强调威权滥用的风险并呼吁对蒸馏进行监管。

contrib.en: Highlights the 'Pacing the Frontier' letter from 1,324 employees of frontier AI companies, expressing concern about competitive pressure and automated AI research.
contrib.zh: 重点介绍了来自前沿 AI 公司 1324 名员工的《Pacing the Frontier》公开信，表达了对竞争压力和自动化 AI 研究的担忧。

contrib.en: Provides concrete examples of AI accelerating development, such as Anthropic using Claude Code for 80% of code and OpenAI's Sol reducing serving costs by 20%.
contrib.zh: 提供了 AI 加速发展的具体例子，如 Anthropic 使用 Claude Code 编写 80%的代码，OpenAI 的 Sol 将服务成本降低 20%。

limits.en: The summary is based on a limited set of open letters and may not represent all perspectives in the AI community.
limits.zh: 该总结基于有限的公开信，可能无法代表 AI 社区的所有观点。

limits.en: The author's personal opinions and sponsorship may introduce bias in the selection and interpretation of events.
limits.zh: 作者的个人观点和赞助可能会在事件的选择和解读中引入偏见。

limits.en: The article focuses on open-weight models and distillation, potentially overlooking other safety concerns like alignment or interpretability.
limits.zh: 文章聚焦于开放权重模型和蒸馏，可能忽略了其他安全问题，如对齐或可解释性。

limits.en: The impact of the letters on actual policy is uncertain, as they represent industry voices rather than regulatory decisions.
limits.zh: 这些公开信对实际政策的影响尚不确定，因为它们代表行业声音而非监管决策。

limits.en: The examples of AI accelerating development are anecdotal and may not generalize to broader trends.
limits.zh: AI 加速发展的例子是轶事性的，可能无法推广到更广泛的趋势。

full.secZh: 关于 AI 发展的公开信

paras.en: I wrote this summary of the past few weeks of open letters as a section of my sponsors-only newsletter, but I've decided to share it here as well.
paras.zh: 我把过去几周关于公开信的总结写成了我赞助者专属通讯的一个部分，但决定也在这里分享。

paras.en: Open Weights and American AI Leadership was shepherded by Microsoft, dated July 24th, and signed by 235 AI-adjacent companies including NVIDIA (see Jensen's first ever tweet), Amazon, Y Combinator, The Linux Foundation, and (a later signer) OpenAI.
paras.zh: 《开放权重与美国 AI 领导力》由微软主导，日期为 7 月 24 日，共有 235 家 AI 相关公司签署，包括 NVIDIA（见 Jensen 有史以来的第一条推文）、亚马逊、Y Combinator、Linux 基金会，以及（后来签署的）OpenAI。

paras.en: It's clearly an argument designed to counter any instincts by the current US government to ban or limit open-weight models over "safety" concerns - a reasonable consideration given what happened to Claude Fable 5!
paras.zh: 这显然是为了反驳当前美国政府因“安全”担忧而禁止或限制开放权重模型的任何倾向——考虑到 Claude Fable 5 的遭遇，这种担忧是合理的！

paras.en: The one surprising note in the letter is that it comes out in support of distillation, where models train on output from other models:
paras.zh: 信中令人惊讶的一点是，它支持蒸馏，即模型在其他模型的输出上进行训练：

paras.en: Notably absent from the signatures: Anthropic, who published their own response, "Our position on open-weights models," three days later. CEO Dario Amodei doubled down on the risk of authoritarian governments building "AI models that are more powerful than those built by the US", and models being "misused to carry out cyberattacks or biological attacks", and called for "a crackdown on industrial-scale distillation operations", while also stating that "Anthropic has never advocated for a ban on open-weights models".
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，Anthropic 缺席签署，并在三天后发布了他们自己的回应《我们对开放权重模型的立场》。CEO Dario Amodei 强调了威权政府构建“比美国更强大的 AI 模型”的风险，以及模型被“滥用于网络攻击或生物攻击”的风险，并呼吁“打击工业规模的蒸馏操作”，同时表示“Anthropic 从未主张禁止开放权重模型”。

paras.en: Then on July 28th, 'Pacing the Frontier' was published, featuring signatures from '1,324 employees of frontier AI companies' - with names like Jakub Pachocki (Chief Scientist, OpenAI), Ilya Sutskever (Safe Superintelligence Inc, previously OpenAI), Dario Amodei (Anthropic), Jack Clark (Anthropic) and more. Their core message:
paras.zh: 随后，7 月 28 日发布了《Pacing the Frontier》，其签名者包括“前沿 AI 公司的 1,324 名员工”——如 Jakub Pachocki（OpenAI 首席科学家）、Ilya Sutskever（Safe Superintelligence Inc，曾任 OpenAI）、Dario Amodei（Anthropic）、Jack Clark（Anthropic）等。他们的核心信息是：

paras.en: Their concern is intense competitive pressure combined with accelerated AI progress caused by automated AI research - and given that Anthropic produces 80% of their code with Claude Code, OpenAI had Sol reduce their end-to-end serving costs by 20%, and Kimi K3 designed a chip to serve a nano model built on its own architecture, you can see why people are taking that risk more seriously right now.
paras.zh: 他们的担忧是，激烈的竞争压力加上由自动化 AI 研究引发的 AI 加速进步——考虑到 Anthropic 用 Claude Code 编写了 80%的代码，OpenAI 让 Sol 将端到端服务成本降低了 20%，以及 Kimi K3 设计了一款芯片来服务基于其自身架构构建的纳米模型，你就可以理解为什么人们现在更加认真地对待这一风险。
